. ( payghumber ney ) mun banaya , aur rukh pher liya ,
iss liye kay unn kay paas woh na-beena aagaya tha .
aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tumhen kiya khabar-? shayad woh sudhar jata ,
ya woh naseehat qubool kerta , aur naseehat kerna ussay faeeda phonchata !
. woh shaks jo bey perwai dikha raha tha ,
uss kay to tum peechay parrtay ho ,
halankay agar woh naa sudhray to tum per koi zimma daari nahi aati ,
aur woh jo mehnat ker kay tumharay paas aaya hai ,
aur woh dil mein Allah ka khof rakhta hai ,
uss ki taraf say tum bey perwai barattay ho !
hergiz aisa nahi chahiye ! yeh Quran to aik naseehat hai ,
abb jo chahye , ussay yaad kerlay ,
woh aesay saheefon mein darj hai jo baray muqaddas hain ,
oonchay rutbay walay hain , pakeezah hain ,
unn likhney walon kay haath mein rehtay hain
jo khud bari izzat walay , boht naik hain .
khuda ki maar ho aesay insan per , woh kitna nashukra hai !
. ( woh zara sochay kay ) Allah ney ussay kiss cheez say peda kiya-?
nutfay ki aik boond say ! ussay peda bhi kiya , phir uss ko aik khaas andaz bhi diya .
phir uss kay liye raasta bhi aasaan bana diya ,
phir ussay moat di , aur qabar mein phoncha diya ,
phir jab chahye ga , ussay dobara utha ker kharra kerday ga .
hergiz nahi ! jiss baat ka Allah ney ussay hukum diya tha , abhi tak uss ney woh poori nahi ki .
phir zara insan apney khaney hi ko dekh ley !
kay hum ney oopper say khoob paani barsaya ,
phir hum ney zameen ko ajeeb tarah phaarra ,
phir hum ney uss mein ghallay ugaye ,
aur angoor aur tarkariyan ,
aur zaitoon aur khujoor ,
aur ghaney ghaney baaghaat ,
aur meway aur chara ,
sabb kuch tumharay aur tumharay maweshiyon kay faeeday ki khatir !
aakhir jab woh kaan phaarney wali aawaz aa-hi jaye gi ,   ( uss waqt iss nashukri ki haqeeqat pata chal jaye gi )
yeh uss din hoga jab insan apney bhai say bhi bhagay ga ,
aur apney maa baap say bhi ,
aur apney biwi bacchon say bhi ,
. ( kiyonkay ) unn mein say her aik ko uss din apni aesi fiker parri hogi kay ussay doosron ka hosh nahi hoga .
uss roz kitney chehray to chamaktay damaktay hon gay ,
hanstay , khushi manatay huye ,
aur kitney chehray uss din aesay hon gay kay unn per khaak parri hogi ,
siyahi ney unhen dhaanp rakha hoga .
yeh wohi log hon gay jo kafir thay , bad-kaar thay .
